journey.name: wear quickpay skips hold
journey.description:
With QuickPay on in the phone's settings, an invoice under the phone's QuickPay amount is paid without the review and without the hold: the link goes straight to sending and the same "Sent" check, and the flow closes by itself. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition, in this order: Private settings wallet, see journeys/wear/README.md › Private settings wallet, never the public test phrase alone, restored on the watch on the local ./spark stack (README › Local ./spark stack) and funded there with at least 2 000 sats before any phone setting changed (README › Private settings wallet, step 5). Then Phone settings on VSS, see README › Phone settings on VSS, with Default Unit Bitcoin, Denomination Modern, Local Currency USD, QuickPay on at $1 and the daily limit at 5× on the phone, and the phone app closed. Watch: the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. The amounts below are in sats and the fiat value in dollars, which is what those units give. The watch reads the phone's settings from the hosted staging VSS whatever Spark network it is on. 200 sats are under $1 while a bitcoin costs less than $500 000.

actions.action: Swipe left three times to the Settings page (README › Watch gestures)
Wait up to 15 s until `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Imported the phone's settings"
Swipe right three times to the Balance page
Wait up to 1 minute until "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads a fiat value: QuickPay needs the rates
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 200` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 20 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed, touching nothing
Verify `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Skipped the hold to pay under QuickPay"
Wait up to 6 s until "WatchHomeBalance" is listed: the flow closed by itself
